blocks.html: Wire your phone to a Harris PRC-152 radio and a Rover video downlink so you can talk point-to-point and watch live aircraft video on the map.

slides.title: Open Radio Controls
slides.html: Tap the Radio icon to open Radio Controls. Harris SA is the PRC-152 voice and data radio; Rover is the ISRV video downlink.

slides.title: Set the PRC-152 cable
slides.html: Connect the PRC-152 cable, then tap the Harris SA gear icon. In Cable Configuration, pick your cable (e.g. PRC-152A Cable) and tap OK.

slides.title: Connect the PRC-152
slides.html: Slide the Harris SA toggle from OFF to ON. Once connected, other radios on the same net appear on the map when squelched.

slides.title: Connect the Rover
slides.html: Slide the Rover toggle from OFF to ON. ATAK scans for a feed; the antenna icon turns green and reads Connected when the downlink is live.

slides.title: Open Rover Controls
slides.html: Tap the Rover menu item to open Rover Controls. The current frequency and waveform show at the top. Use Scan and Next to step through feeds.

slides.title: Set frequency and waveform
slides.html: Tap Scan to open Scan Frequency Range. Enter a Start Freq Code and End Freq Code, pick the Waveform (e.g. ANALOG, DDL), and tap OK, then Next to advance.

slides.title: Watch the video
slides.html: Tap Watch to open the live stream. The video shows the aircraft sensor feed with target grid and coordinates overlaid.
